title: Asset observations and environmental context
reason: Phase3 proposal only. Reuses unit/time foundations and connects reference metadata to observations. Strong showcase after real typed query value; earthquakes remain optional reserve rather than displacing daily operational utility. EA beta service/no SLA, 15-minute periods, datum/qualifier and negative stage; never use rejected whole readings.value→stage mapping. POWER date-keyed parameter objects require typed unpivot, units and fill -999; observed bounded three days do not prove historical coverage. Nearest station/grid is contextual association, not flood or safety prediction; no causal claim. NOAA global rights and Open-Meteo free-service commercial restriction prevent shortcut substitution.
practical_value: 72.6/100 proposal value; readiness gated independently. I connect assets with explicit coordinates or EA measure URIs; inspect typed observations; choose a bounded date range; compare observed station values with separate grid weather context after approved temporal/spatial aggregation.
showcase_value: 5/5, excluded from practical score; Which readings and units belong to the selected asset/measure and time window?
